title: YouCoded and YouCoded Night — first look in the app

steps.path: The first screen after setup (before = Midnight, today's default; switch YouCoded / YouCoded Night with the light/dark buttons)
steps.headline: The first-time welcome: your D1 form, mascot beside the heading, on the new picture.
steps.changed: Purple tokens tuned to pass every contrast check; the picture behind see-through panels (16px blur); Outfit for interface text, the code font kept for code and the terminal.
steps.notice: A new install opens in whichever of the two matches the computer's light or dark setting. People already using the app keep their theme.
steps.risk: The mascot is still today's grey robot; the glass buddy is the next design round.
